title: Career Roadmap: Site Supervisor
summary: Career objective: Supervise daily construction or interior-fit-out activities, coordinate workers and contractors, monitor quality and progress, and ensure work follows drawings, specifications, safety requirements, and schedules.

items.text: Diploma in Interior Design / Interior Construction

blocks.text: Choose construction technology for building-site work; choose interior design for finishing, fit-outs, and interiors.

blocks.label: Software
blocks.text: AutoCAD basics, Excel, drawing/PDF viewers, and project scheduling fundamentals.

blocks.label: Site measurement report
blocks.text: Measure a room or small building and prepare a dimensioned layout.

blocks.label: Quantity estimation
blocks.text: Calculate approximate material quantities for flooring, painting, masonry, or plastering.

blocks.label: Daily progress report
blocks.text: Track completed work, labour, materials, delays, and pending activities.

blocks.label: Quality checklist
blocks.text: Prepare inspection checklists for concrete, masonry, tiling, painting, or interior installations.

blocks.label: Project schedule
blocks.text: Create a simple construction sequence and timeline using Excel or scheduling software.
Prioritize actual site exposure, drawing interpretation, measurement, material inspection, safety procedures, and coordination with contractors.
Progression depends on project experience, technical competence, qualifications, and employer requirements. Project Manager positions may require additional education or substantial site experience.

items.text: B.Tech / B.E. Civil Engineering, where eligibility permits
PG Diploma in Construction Project Management
MBA in Project Management, for management-oriented progression

blocks.text: For regulated or technically responsible roles, verify the applicable qualification and licensing requirements.

By graduation, the student should be able to read basic drawings, measure site dimensions, estimate common materials, prepare daily reports, inspect workmanship, coordinate workers, and follow site safety procedures.
